description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableSortOption' implementing the 'SortOption' interface, representing sorting options with entries, supporting addition, iteration, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableSortOption
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the SortOption interface, managing a list of SortOptionEntry objects, providing methods for creation, modification, and retrieval.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSortOption instance with the provided list of entries, ensuring the list is not null.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing OptionVisitor and calls its visit method with this object.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of sort option entries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new SortOptionEntry to the current sort option, returning a new ImmutableSortOption instance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates and adds a new ImmutableSortOptionEntry with the given property path and order.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of the entries.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the entries.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on entries list.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on entries.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the sort options, formatted as 'sort(entry1,entry2,...)'.
